alt_text.short: Diagram that shows figure ARCH-01 — End-to-End ETL Migration Accelerator Architecture.
alt_text.long: Legacy ETL Source Estates: Alteryx Designer, Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica IDMC. Intake & Canonical ETL IR: Secure Staging & Dedup, Source Adapters & Canonical IR, Assessment & Effort Engine. Microsoft Fabric Compilers: Dataflow Gen2 M Compiler, Fabric PySpark Notebook Compiler, Pipeline Bundler & Scaffolds. Microsoft Fabric Dev Serving: Dataflow Gen2 & Notebooks, Fabric Data Pipelines, Readback & executeQuery Check. Consumer & Delivery Layer: React Portfolio UI & Typer CLI, Assessment & Bundle Exports, Migration & Data Engineers. Security, Secretless CI/CD Dispatch & InnerSource Governance Control Plane: Chrysalis SDL & InnerSource, GitHub Actions & GitLab CI, Microsoft Entra OIDC Federation, Deploy-FabricArtifacts.ps1. Flows: z_sources to z_intake_ir (ETL exports); z_intake_ir to Fabric PySpark Notebook Compiler (IR DAG); z_compilers to z_control_plane (Item envelopes); Chrysalis SDL & InnerSource to GitHub Actions & GitLab CI (SDL gates); GitHub Actions & GitLab CI to Microsoft Entra OIDC Federation (OIDC JWT); Microsoft Entra OIDC Federation to Deploy-FabricArtifacts.ps1 (Entra token); Deploy-FabricArtifacts.ps1 to z_fabric (Fabric REST); z_fabric to z_consumers (Validated items).
zones: Security, Secretless CI/CD Dispatch & InnerSource Governance Control Plane
